name: Energy-Based Daily Planner

listing.title: Printable Energy-Based Daily Planner | Flexible Routine Sheets
listing.description:
A printable planner that helps you plan your day around your energy, not a strict hour-by-hour schedule.

Inside: a cover, a How to use page, the Energy-Based Daily Plan page, a Low-Energy Reset Sheet for tough days, the Weekly Capacity & Rhythm page and the Unload & Sort page.

Print it on A4 or US Letter paper, as often as you need, for personal use.
listing.buyer: adults looking for a simple, flexible planning system tailored to daily energy levels

instructions: Print the A4 or US Letter file at 100% (actual size).
Each morning, tick your energy level and pick tasks that fit it.
On hard days, use the Low-Energy Reset Sheet instead.
